welcome.title: Portfolium
welcome.subtitle: Gather your data once and generate multiple presentations.
welcome.terms: By continuing, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
welcome.hub_desc: Portfolio Builder structures your information, experiences, and tech stack in a centralized format. Keep everything in one place.
welcome.results_desc: You fill in the data just once. We transform your profile into different optimized outputs.
welcome.result_portfolio_desc: A responsive, styled, and dynamic website ready to be hosted on GitHub Pages.
welcome.result_readme_desc: A structured Markdown file to make your GitHub profile look amazing.
welcome.result_cv_desc: A clean, professional, and ATS-friendly document for your next job application.
welcome.integrations_desc: Connect with platforms you already use to automatically import your data.
welcome.privacy_desc: No login required. We don't store your data on our servers. Everything is processed locally on your device and can be exported anytime.

profile.title: Let's start with your profile
profile.subtitle: Tell us a bit about yourself and how you want to be presented.
profile.about_placeholder: A brief summary of who you are, your experience, and what you do.

projects.title: Add your projects
projects.subtitle: Choose the projects you want to include in your portfolio.
projects.empty_state: No projects added yet. Add one manually or import your GitHub repositories.

skills.title: Review your technologies
skills.subtitle: Select the technologies you want to highlight.
skills.info_message: You can add, remove, or reorganize any technology.

ai.title: AI suggestions
ai.subtitle: This step is optional.
ai.use_my_ai_desc: Use your preferred artificial intelligence tool.
ai.use_my_ai_info: Copy the data, review it in your preferred tool, and import the result.
ai.free_ai_desc: Use the model provided by Portfolio Builder.
ai.free_ai_info: ⏱ There may be usage limits or a queue.
ai.no_ai_desc: Your data is ready. You can generate your portfolio without using artificial intelligence.
ai.limit_desc: Free AI can summarize up to 10 projects at a time. Choose which projects you want to process.
ai.limit_reached_desc: You can select up to 10 projects using Free AI. Deselect a project to choose another.
ai.error_profile_desc: Could not generate the suggestion. Original description will be kept.
ai.generating_projects_desc: We are analyzing your projects. This may take a moment.
ai.total_failure_desc: No descriptions were changed. Try again later or use your personal AI.
ai.partial_failure_desc: Projects with errors will keep their original descriptions.
ai.success_generated_desc: Review the texts and indicate which ones are useful before continuing.
ai.fallback_alert: The main service is temporarily unavailable. We will continue using the fallback service.
ai.discarded_msg: This summary will not be used. The original project description will be kept.
ai.error_kept_original: The original project description will be kept.
ai.profile_approved_msg: The new professional description will be used in your portfolio.
ai.profile_rejected_msg: The AI suggestion will not be used. Your original professional description will be kept in the portfolio.
ai.no_original_profile: You don't have an original professional description. Go back to the profile step to add one.
ai.cancel_flow_desc: Original descriptions will be kept. Are you sure?
ai.success_desc: Useful summaries and professional description (if approved) were successfully applied to your portfolio.

github.no_repos_found: No repositories found matching your filters.
github.rate_limit_exceeded: Request limit reached. Please try again later.
github.rate_limit_exceeded_dev: GitHub API rate limit exceeded for this IP. Add a GITHUB_TOKEN in your .env file to enable 5,000 requests/hour.
github.fetch_error: Could not connect to GitHub. Please check your connection and try again.

profile_orbit.description: Define the order of elements floating around your photo. They will be visually distributed across the corners of the layout.
